item.title: Aya: Forest Town, Crafts & Sake — Guide
item.description: Aya, a small town in the green highlands inland from Miyazaki city, is renowned as one of Japan’s leading eco-towns, built around the protection of its magnificent natural forest. It holds Japan’s largest surviving expanse of primeval evergreen laurel (broadleaf) forest, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, best experienced from the Aya Teruha Suspension Bridge — one of the highest pedestrian suspension bridges of its kind — which spans a deep green valley with spectacular views over the forest canopy.
